title: Kagamine Len — Sparkling Curiosity☆〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: An Ode for the Pure of Heart

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Where could Rui be?
I hope he gets here soon...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Heya, Rui!
Thanks for coming today!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, it's my pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As promised, I'm here to help teach you how to make some simple devices.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Awesome! So what are we gonna make?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's start with this part first. I'm sure you'll figure it out soon after...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
A tube...? Or a barrel...?
I know, it's a cannon!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's correct, Len! Nicely done!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yay!
Wait, you think I can make one of those?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No need to worry. It's a simplified design based off an existing kit, so it shouldn't be difficult.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've also made the blueprint as simple as I could as well. For example, these red lines correspond to the red lines on the circuit board.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, cool. And these blue lines are talking about these blue parts, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Correct.
Let's begin by making the control panel then.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Red goes to red...
Uh oh... It didn't go on straight...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mind if I take a look?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sure, is it gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. It's on there just fine and shouldn't have any trouble conducting.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
Alright, I have to loosen this plug by untightening its screw...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I... I'm done!!
I think I'm done, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Well done, Len.
But we're not quite done yet.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that you've finished, we'll need to test it out.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, right now?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Of course.
There's something I'd also like to test out...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Like what?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um... They're pieces of paper... Shaped like fairies...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I made them from pieces of construction paper. I'll take these ten cutouts, add a vertical crease and bend their arms and wings slightly...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Cool...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your little cannon is made to go right along with them!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? What's gonna happen?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You'll just have to see to find out. Why not try pressing the switch?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright! Then here... We...
Go!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! The fairies are flying!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, they are. Your cannon seems to be working just fine! Congratulations, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Heh heh heh! Oh, but what happened to the thing you wanted to try out, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's up to our little fairy friends...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, it looks like they're also working well. See...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow! That's amazing...!
That one's spinning around like it's dancing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Rui, you gotta tell me!
How's it able to do that?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Think of it as a bamboo-copter made out of paper. Its arms are shaped in such a way to act as a propeller.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It creates lift by spinning around and dances its way gently back down to the ground.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's so cool! I didn't know you could make anything like that! You're so smart, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
But some didn't seem to make it. They just came crashing back down without doing much else.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have to think that the initial thrust from being launched caused too much damage to the paper. This is good. I can take that into consideration next time...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Next time?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We can't have that happen during a show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'll keep experimenting through trial and error as many times as I need to until it becomes safe to use.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (So he's been doing this without any of us really knowing what was going on. All this work...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Rui really is amazing!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, Rui...
How do you come up with all these ideas?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I usually just think about how the characters or our audience will feel during each scene as I read a script.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
For example...
I was wondering how we could make it so that the audience feels like they're in a forest of fairies...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then I thought, “Eureka! I'll just have the fairies dance for them!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The “how” became a question of making them dance while they're floating in the sky. That's how I arrived on the bamboo-copter idea.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, okay. So you think about what kind of effects you want!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Each effect is just an added option. The goal is to make the show as fun as possible.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I do occasionally arrive on effects before I've seen anything at all... But I've never based my shows around them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Really?!
There's so much going on in that brain of yours, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It kind of makes me happy too...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Happy?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO taught me a lot about how to put on shows and I love making it so that everyone smiles!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And the way you talked just now, Rui, it told me that you really love seeing and putting on shows too...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm really happy about how we sort of think alike!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “We think alike...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I understand how you feel as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Especially now that I have this troupe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, we'll need to make some improvements to these fairies and test them out once more...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How does that sound, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do it, Rui!
